listed_sector_signals.signal: An interviewed specialist reports implementing EnMS and ISO 50001 in petrochemicals; production mode is unspecified.
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Answer: I have no experience of 
working with FPSOs but have extensive 
experience internationally of imple­
menting EnMS and ISO 50001 in the 
petrochemical sector among many oth­
ers. Experience shows that an effective 
EnMs has very significant benefits in 
terms of improving energy performance, 
reducing costs and GHG emissions.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Petrochemical activities are explicitly included in the standards committee's scope.
listed_sector_signals.quote:
ISO/TC 67's scope revolves around the 
standardization in the oil & gas sector, 
including petrochemical and lower 
carbon energy activities.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Hydrogen is mentioned among decarbonization technologies, without a production application.
listed_sector_signals.quote:
and advancements in hydrogen, carbon 
capture utilization and storage (CCUS),

listed_sector_signals.signal: Offshore ammonia storage appears in the standardization scope; this is a storage-only mention.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The empirical qualitative research concerns energy management on FPSO oil-production platforms.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The data presented herein stems 
from a qualitative research endeavor 
focused on energy management within 
FPSO platform ships, specifically utilized 
for oil production in ultra-deep waters.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: Upstream offshore oil production and FPSOs

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: An FPSO specialist identifies gas-turbine electricity generation and gas compression as energy-management challenges.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Answer: Optimizing electric power 
generation systems (currently based on 
gas-consuming aero-derivative turbines) 
and enhancing the energy efficiency of gas 
compression systems.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: Offshore power generation and gas compression

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: ADNOC offshore sites are presented as an ISO 50001 implementation case.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The implementation of ISO 50001 
standards has yielded remarkable results 
in the sector, particularly evident in the 
achievements of ADNOC in the United 
Arab Emirates. With 11 offshore sites 
located near Abu Dhabi, ADNOC has 
demonstrated a significant commitment 
to reducing its environmental footprint.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: Upstream offshore oil and gas operations

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The West Madura Offshore implementation case explicitly includes processing platforms and an onshore receiving facility.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Operating key facilities including the Po­
leng Processing Platform (PPP), Central 
Processing Platform (CPP), and Onshore 
Receiving Facility (ORF), the company 
has prioritized energy management prac­
tices to reduce its carbon footprint.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The Safaniya Offshore Producing Department case reports measured energy-performance improvement.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Through strategic manage­
ment applied to practices, SOfPD has 
achieved relevant outcomes, including a 
remarkable 38.9% improvement in energy 
performance over one year, resulting in 
substantial energy cost avoidance of US$ 
7.4 million.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: Upstream offshore oil and gas production

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Yumen Oil Field is presented as an ISO 50001 certification and energy-management implementation case.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The case of the Yumen Field, with 
operation by Chinese CNPC, was the first 
oil field in the company to achieve ISO 
50001 certification, exemplifies the trans­
formative impact of energy management 
systems (EnMS) as a crucial avenue for 
enhancing revenue, curbing expenditure, 
reducing costs, and amplifying efficiency.

one_line: The paper reviews energy-management standards using FPSO expert interviews and upstream oil-and-gas implementation cases, with additional testimony about petrochemical EnMS experience.
